sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. Tight head-and-shoulders naval portrait with torso angled slightly toward screen-left and face turned almost to the viewer. White soft-crowned peaked naval cap, black band and glossy black visor, gold anchor-and-wreath badge, gold horizontal cap cord/braid and gold decorative visor marks. Preserve the cap shape, angle and slight clipping at the upper canvas edge. Dark arched brows, wide attentive eyes and a serious neutral closed mouth. No eyewear; upper lip, cheeks and chin have no separately visible moustache or beard, and the dark mouth/skin shading must not become added facial hair. Scalp hair is covered by the cap, with only tiny dark temple edges visible; do not invent an exposed hairstyle. Very dark navy/black coat with broad overlapping notched lapels, pale gray-white pointed shirt collar and narrow dark patterned tie. No visible chest medals or shoulder insignia. Small headroom, lower chest/shoulders cropped by canvas edges, soft stronger light from above/screen-left and deeper screen-right facial shade. Muted pale gray-green painted background fills the entire rectangle. No photo card, note, caption or transparent exterior. Original measured alpha255 throughout. Tiny badge internals are not fully readable beyond the actual gold anchor/wreath and braid shapes; preserve those visible shapes without inventing a named insignia.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Tight chest-up naval portrait with shoulders angled toward screen-left, face turned a little toward screen-left and gaze near the viewer. Broad white-gray peaked cap, black band, gold anchor with surrounding gold leaf shapes, shiny black visor and dense gold leaf-like embroidery along the visor edge. Dark eyebrows, neutral slightly parted lips, smooth cheeks, upper lip and chin; no visible moustache, beard or eyewear. Hair is largely hidden by the cap, so retain only the small visible dark temple edge rather than adding an exposed hairstyle. Dark navy/black coat with broad notched overlapping lapels, white/light-gray pointed shirt collar and a dark gray-black necktie. No visible medals or shoulder insignia. Preserve this cap tilt and face/shoulder angle, the close headroom and cropped lower chest, screen-left highlights and screen-right shade. Full pale gray-green painted background remains to every canvas edge. No frame, note, caption or exterior cutout; alpha255 throughout. The small badge details are readable only as the visible anchor/leaf shapes, not a precise named design.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Tight near-frontal head-and-shoulders portrait with a broad gray-white peaked naval cap whose crown reaches and is slightly clipped by the top canvas edge. Black cap band and visor, gold anchor-and-wreath badge and gold leaf-like embroidery across the visor. Very short gray side hair is visible beneath the cap. Furrowed dark/gray brows, serious eyes directed near the viewer, a short dense salt-and-pepper full beard across cheeks, jaw and chin joined to a gray/dark moustache, and slightly parted neutral lips. No eyewear. Dark navy/black naval jacket with broad notched lapels, pale white-gray pointed shirt collar and dark tie; no visible chest medals or shoulder insignia. Preserve the frontal shoulders, close upper crop, cut-off chest, stronger screen-left light and the darker screen-right face. Pale muted gray-green painted backdrop fills the entire rectangle; no card frame, note or caption. Original alpha230..255, with zero fully transparent pixels; keep the complete painted canvas/backdrop rather than making an isolated transparent figure. Tiny badge internals are unresolved beyond the actual anchor/wreath and gold visor shapes.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Tight frontal head-and-shoulders naval portrait, nearly symmetrical shoulders and gaze toward the viewer. Gray-white peaked cap, broad black band, black visor with gold leaf-like embroidery, horizontal gold cord, and a dark badge containing a pale anchor surrounded by gold leaves with a small gold star above. Hair is mostly concealed by the cap; preserve the short dark visible side edges without inventing scalp detail. Dark brows, serious slightly parted lips, a distinct dark moustache, short narrow jaw/side beard growth and a dense short dark chin tuft with some gray flecks. No eyewear. Dark navy/black uniform jacket with broad notched lapels, gray pointed shirt collar and dark tie. Shoulder straps carry small gold star-like marks/round gold buttons visible at the edges; no visible chest medals. Preserve the small headroom, side and lower crop, warm screen-left highlights and darker screen-right facial shading. Muted pale gray-green painted backdrop fills the complete rectangular canvas; no card, note, caption or exterior cutout. Measured alpha249..255, no zero-alpha pixels; preserve the full painted backdrop. Tiny shoulder/badge internal markings cannot be fully resolved; retain the visible mark groups without inventing detailed rank or a named insignia.
